# Odoo only stores key hashes, so mint a fresh key for the current user. # Earlier keys are kept: Yengeç may still be using one of them. # Only admins reach this action, and Odoo lets them mint a persistent key (no expiry): # there is no refresh, so an expiring key would break the connection. api_key = env['res.users.apikeys']._generate('rpc', 'Yengeç Connector', None)
integration = env.context.get('yengec_integration') or '' params = env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo() # Odoo 20 replaced get_param with typed accessors such as get_str; builds from # before that change (Odoo Online rolls out gradually) only have get_param. try: base_url = params.get_str('web.base.url', '') except Exception: base_url = params.get_param('web.base.url', '') query = [ ('base_url', base_url), ('database', env.cr.dbname), ('username', env.user.login), ('integration', integration), ('utm_source', 'odoo'), ('utm_medium', 'odoo-app'), ('utm_campaign', 'yengec_' + (integration or 'connector')), ] # urllib is not available to server actions, so escape what would break the query string. encoded = '&'.join( '%s=%s' % (name, value.replace('%', '%25').replace('&', '%26').replace('#', '%23').replace('+', '%2B').replace(' ', '%20')) for name, value in query ) action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_url', 'target': 'new', # The fragment is never sent to a server, so the key stays out of access logs. 'url': 'https://app.yengec.co/auth/odoo?%s#api_key=%s' % (encoded, api_key), }
